_policy: B4 media review. An item is published only after a person looked at it (image) or played it in Chrome (video, scripts/catalog/check-videos.mjs). Accept: Everkinetic line art (credited to Everkinetic even when re-uploaded by a wger user) and named contributors' own photos/videos showing the exercise correctly. Reject: anonymous uploads (no traceable author), images whose wger record names a commercial derivative source, commercial-library 3D renders, watermarks / AI-generator marks, decorative art that does not teach the movement, and wrong exercise. Value: "ok" | {"ok": true, "credit": "..."} | "reject: reason". Refinement (lead review, 2026-10-22): a frame of an Everkinetic series — same wger folder and file series as a frame wger credits to Everkinetic, licence CC BY-SA 3.0, line-art style — is credited to Everkinetic even when wger left the author field empty (e.g. img:3, Crunches-1, companion of img:4).
